description_en: Create a Historical Data Cleanup ticket
description_zh: 创建历史数据清理工单
name: CreateDataCronClearOrder

parameters.help_en: The purpose or objective of the data change. This reduces unnecessary communication
parameters.help_zh: 业务背景，以减少沟通成本
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The stakeholders of this operation. All stakeholders can view the ticket details and assist in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than Data Management (DMS) administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details
parameters.name: related_user_list

fields.help_en: The reason for the data change
fields.name: classify

fields.help_zh: 字段名。字段为日期类型
fields.name: column_name

fields.help_en: The retention period of the historical data. Unit: days. For example, if you set the parameter to 7, DMS deletes the data that is retained for more than seven days
fields.help_zh: 保留时长，即历史数据清理的规则，单位为天。例如您配置为7天，DMS将在执行时删除7天前的数据
fields.name: remain_days

fields.help_en: The name of the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to query the name of the table
fields.help_zh: 表名，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html接口获取该参数
fields.name: table_name

fields.help_en:
The type of time granularity. If the ColumnName parameter specifies a field of a time type, this parameter is required. Valid values:

MILLISECONDS: milliseconds
SECONDS: seconds
fields.help_zh:
时间精度类型，当选择字段为日期数值型存储时使用，取值：
MILLISECONDS：毫秒
SECONDS：秒
fields.name: time_unit

fields.help_en: The tables for which you want to clear historical data
fields.name: cron_clear_item_list

fields.help_en: The crontab expression that you can use to run the task at a specified time. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206581.html
fields.help_zh: Crontab表达式，以便定期执行任务，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206581.html
fields.name: cron_format

fields.help_en: The ID of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to query the ID of the database
fields.name: db_id

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is not a logical database
fields.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值：
true：是
false：否
fields.name: logic

fields.help_en: The databases for which you want to clear historical data
fields.name: db_item_list

fields.help_en:
The amount of time taken to run the task. Unit: hours.

If the specifyDuration parameter is set to true, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
执行时长，单位为小时。
当specifyDuration参数为true时，该参数必填
fields.name: duration_hour

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to specify an end time for the task. Valid values:

true: specifies an end time for the task. The task is automatically suspended after this end time.
false: does not specify an end time for the task. The task is stopped after the historical data is cleared
fields.help_zh:
是否指定执行时长，取值：
true：指定执行时长，到达指定时间后即停止执行。
false：不指定执行时长，直到清理结束
fields.name: specify_duration

parameters.help_en:
The key of the attachment for the ticket. The attachment provides more instructions for this operation.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to query the key of the attachment
parameters.help_zh:
工单补充附件，对本次操作进行补充说明。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: attachment_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

The ID of the tenant is displayed when you move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the Manage DMS tenants topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
